items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: Sheik was just a guy that always would buy, and he'd call himself interested in music... Sheik was just a man that would come in at any time... he always was a, you know, a friendly type of guy.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. What were you telling us before we got the tape on about where he came from, the plantation of? Derridge. Derridge. That's across the river. That's on the other side. Oh. Yeah. And you were telling us about when Sheik and Howard came by for lessons. Do you remember them coming to the house?

Sheik used to come all the time and take lessons. My dad would try to learn different things about, you know, the expression and the feelings of music. You see, you don't just have to know music. Mm-hmm. You know, you have to play what you feel as well. Mm-hmm.
